title: cylindrolobus tenuicaulis
intro: Cylindrolobus tenuicaulis, commonly known as the Chinese goldthread, is a plant species that belongs to the Berberidaceae family. It is valued for its potential health benefits, including anti-inflammatory, antimicrobial, and antioxidant properties, which can help to protect against various diseases. The therapeutic actions of Cylindrolobus tenuicaulis include its ability to act as an immunomodulator, anti-viral agent, and to exert anti-cancer effects through its cytotoxic activity. The bioactive constituents of this plant include alkaloids, flavonoids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
